Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my solid clinical foundation, strong communication abilities, and dedication to patient‑centered care can contribute to the excellent standards of St. Mary’s Regional Medical Center.

Sincerely,  

Aisha Khan
